description.zh: 任务描述信息。长度不超过100个字符。
description.en: The task description. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符。
description.en: The job ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the job.

description.zh: 任务下每分钟推送的作业数量。取值范围为50~1000。
description.en: The number of jobs pushed per minute under the task. Valid values: 50 to 1000.

description.zh:
任务下作业执行的超时时间。

更多信息，请参见下文“TimeoutConfig定义”。
description.en:
The timeout period for job execution under the task.

For more information, see "TimeoutConfig definition" below.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 5.

 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-job --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --description jobDescription --timeout-config inProgressTimeoutInMinutes=60 --rollout-config maximumPerMinute=1000 --job-id XUbmsMHmkqv0PiAG0000010001 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateJob --region cn-hangzhou --RolloutConfig '{"maximumPerMinute":1000}' --TimeoutConfig '{"inProgressTimeoutInMinutes":60}' --Description jobDescription --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --JobId XUbmsMHmkqv0PiAG0000010001
